what: The window reads count only recorded features (physical_features revision > 0). Niagara's
41,809 buildings are 21 REVIEWED packages not yet confirmed (area revision 0), so the summ
ary answers 200 with featureCount 0 and extent null, while context and canonical still ref
use 422 AREA_LIMIT because they also count the packages' unrecorded proposals. LA1 was pro
ved on recorded features; this area has none.
With extent null the window mode makes no window read, shows no status line, no banner and
no inspector: the officer sees a blank map with no sentence saying why, after the batch s
aid on_map.
